script_text: Stop! Cancer, the Moon is pulling at your Water sign and your secrets are about to surface. On November 8, 2026, Mercury forms a tense square to your ruling Moon in your 7th House of Partnerships. Jupiter in your 2nd House trines Saturn in your 11th, steadying your finances while conversations turn sharp. For love, that square warns a partner may test your boundaries tonight, so do not withdraw into silence. Single Cancers should watch for a magnetic stranger linked to work, not home. In career and money, Mercury in your 10th House favors a difficult email or negotiation before noon. Say less, document everything, and money promised last week may finally move. Avoid making a permanent promise when emotions spike, because an unexpected blessing lands through an older friend instead. Follow for tomorrow's reading, Cancer, because the Moon shifts again and changes everything.
